external_classification.classification_scope: PGL-inequivalent (k,2)-arcs in PG(2,q), not necessarily complete
external_classification.independent_generation_check: the thesis reports the orbit-stabilizer/double-count consistency check for every (k,2)-arc classification with q<=27
external_classification.known_representative: a nondegenerate conic has 18 points; deleting two gives a 16-arc
external_classification.source: H. Sticker, Classification of Arcs in Small Desarguesian Projective Planes, PhD thesis, Ghent University, 2012
external_classification.unique_class_consequence: every 16-arc in PG(2,17) is projectively equivalent to conic-minus-two

sharp_lift.equality_rigidity: B is Boolean and every paired cube through a support point has minimum degree-two support 1/4

survivor_geometry: conic minus its tangent point at infinity and one affine point
